# SortableJS (vendored)

- Version: 1.15.6
- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable
- Bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.6/Sortable.min.js

Self-hosted so the dashboard makes no third-party network calls and the
version is pinned to a known build.

Used by:
- src/views/pages/overview.ejs (drag-and-drop card arrange mode)

To upgrade: download a new minified bundle, replace Sortable.min.js, then
verify the overview arrange mode still reorders cards.
